message: Well, everyone, I feel as though I am reading my problems with T-NETIX over and overagain. I am in Indiana and daughter is incarcerated in Indiana. The same thing happened with me,no notification of the change to T-NETIX, I owed X amount of dollars, "pay now for only an additional $4.00 charge to process the payment". I did that, gave my SS# for a credit check, was told I had $100.00 credit each month. The next thing I know, another "BLOCK" is on my line and they tell me I only have $1.00 credit and I have to contact the supervisor "Derek". That was about a month ago and I still can't receive calls from her. No one seems to know who "Derek" is and in the mean time I cannot talk to my daughter..T-NETIX better get a clue, I can see a Class Action law suit coming!
